beaconsoftware-beaconsoftware:ashbyhq:76.title: Strategic Finance Director
beaconsoftware-beaconsoftware:ashbyhq:76.description: ABOUT BEACON SOFTWARE Beacon https://beaconsoftware.com/ is building the essential technology infrastructure for the everyday economy: the businesses, organizations, and services that make real life work, and that mainstream tech has largely left behind. We acquire, operate, and grow vertical market software companies. They are niche, founder-built businesses serving industries that are often overlooked and too profitable to ignore. Our model is simple: we seek out founders who have built their business by spending years understanding their market and prioritizing their customers' specific needs. We buy great businesses, invest in their continued growth, and hold them permanently, accelerating that growth with an AI-native platform built specifically for vertical market software. No mandate to cut, flip, or roll up into something unrecognizable. We are not a financial firm. We are technology entrepreneurs and operators who believe the most important businesses in the world are already running quietly in industries most people never think about. Our job is to find them, support the people who built them, and make them better. Beacon is backed by a diverse base of investors, with $550M+ raised to date, including General Catalyst, Lightspeed, D1 Capital, CPMG, the family offices of the founders of Stripe, DoorDash, and Ramp, and evergreen funds built for the long game. ROLE AND MISSION This is an exciting and entrepreneurial opportunity to join a fast-paced technology company with a very significant growth trajectory. Beacon Software is making its first hire on the Strategic Finance team. This is a role where investing turns into building. The individual will report to Beacon’s VP, Strategic Finance and work closely with Beacon’s CEO, CTO, M&A Directors, industry pod leaders, and the General Managers of Beacon’s portfolio companies. The Strategic Finance team’s mandate spans the financial decisions that shape Beacon: partnering with portfolio companies on growth and value creation, building AI-native systems that let functions scale non-linearly with the portfolio, owning Beacon’s capital allocation across organic and inorganic strategies, leading new strategy extensions beyond core software M&A, and building Beacon’s capital markets capability. Team members work across a mix of these areas based on their interests and skillset. This is an asymmetric opportunity to build a company, with decision authority and velocity over process driving compounding equity. You’ll sit next to the CEO on capital allocation and capital markets, or fill a CFO role across dozens of companies on their most consequential decisions. The playbook will be shaped by you with the goal of building Beacon into a $100B company. To succeed in this role, this individual should be an enthusiastic and energetic self-starter, with the ability to translate operator intuition into financial decisions and build the analytical rigor behind Beacon’s platform-level bets. The ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously across portfolio companies and platform initiatives will be essential. We are seeking a collaborative professional who wants to contribute ideas on how to improve the status quo and create best-practices that will accelerate our execution. Teamwork and positivity are key foundations of this growing team’s culture and ethos. Location: for discussion. Beacon has offices in Toronto, San Francisco, New York, and Chicago. WHAT YOU'LL DO Finance partner to acquired companies - Partner with industry sector leaders and portfolio company General Managers as the financial decision-making engine across Beacon’s portfolio companies. - Translate product, AI, and operator intuition into investment decisions: pricing changes, sales hires, direct marketing investments, engineering allocation, and tuck-in M&A. - Build value creation plans, set budgets and targets, and make the day-to-day capital decisions that drive growth across companies. embeddingvc-embedding-vc:ashbyhq:ea84166.title: AI Agent Tech Lead
embeddingvc-embedding-vc:ashbyhq:ea84166.description: About Lingopal Lingopal builds real-time AI language technology, with a live translation product used in production today. We're now building our next product — an AI agent platform aimed at enterprises with heavy customer-support needs (hospitality, airlines, travel) and fast-scaling AI-agent companies. About the Role We're looking for a AI Agent Tech Lead to be an early, hands-on builder for our new AI agent product — and to grow into technical leadership as the team scales. You'll work directly with the founders, own core backend/full-stack systems, and move fast: we're testing with pilot customers in Q4 2026, and the direction will sharpen based on what we learn. Speed and adaptability matter more here than infrastructure depth or performance optimization — we need someone who ships. What You'll Do - Build the core of a new AI agent product end-to-end — backend and full-stack, from prototype to pilot. - Turn rough product direction into shipped features fast, iterating with real pilot customers. - Make the early, high-leverage technical decisions and set the engineering bar as the team grows. - Grow into technical leadership — mentoring, hiring, and owning architecture as we scale. - Work hands-on with modern AI tooling (LLMs, agents, voice AI) as a daily part of the job. What We're Looking For - 1–5 years of software engineering experience — strong hands-on builder, comfortable owning things end-to-end. - AI agent background preferred (agent frameworks, LLM-powered products, voice AI a plus). - Backend / full-stack strength. - Startup mindset — we lean toward startup/YC-caliber builders over Big Tech pedigree; rapid feature development over performance tuning. - Comfortable with ambiguity and evolving priorities; high ownership and a bias toward shipping. - Wants to grow into a leadership role.

gendigital-gen-digital:ashbyhq:40b7c825-.title: Product Marketing & GTM Lead Manager - LifeLock
gendigital-gen-digital:ashbyhq:40b7c825-.description: ABOUT GEN: Gen is a global company dedicated to powering Digital Freedom through its trusted consumer brands including Norton, Avast, LifeLock, MoneyLion and more. Our combined heritage is rooted in financial empowerment and cyber safety for the first digital generations, and today we deliver award-winning cybersecurity, online privacy, identity protection and financial wellness solutions to nearly 500 million users in more than 150 countries. Together, we share a collective passion and vision to protect consumers and help them grow, manage and secure their digital and financial lives. We’re always looking for smart, fearless and high-impact talent who see AI as a teammate – leveraging it to move faster and deliver meaningful results. When you’re part of Gen, you’ll have the flexibility, tools and support to do your best work and grow your career – from flexible working options and time off to competitive pay, benefits and well-being programs. At Gen, we are scrappy and relentlessly customer driven. We create room for healthy debate, experimentation and continuous learning, and we seek out people with different experiences, identities and ideas to join our team. You’ll work with people who back each other, respect each other and understand that our differences are a competitive advantage. If this sounds like you, we’d love you to be part of Gen. ABOUT THE ROLE: This role sits at the center of Product, Brand, Growth, Analytics, Regional Marketing, and Channel teams—owning the development of differentiated product positioning and ensuring flawless orchestration of launches from strategy through in-market optimization. The role combines product marketing leadership with integrated marketing and GTM execution, ensuring clear storytelling, disciplined launch planning, operational excellence, and measurable business impact. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: Product Positioning & Messaging Leadership · Own marketing positioning and messaging for products and launches, crafting clear, compelling, and differentiated product narratives. · Define messaging architecture aligned to target audiences and product strategy. · Develop high-impact product copy, value propositions, key selling points, and feature narratives. · Maintain and evolve foundational product storytelling assets including videos, screenshots, and hero product materials. End-to-End Launch Strategy & GTM Ownership · Define comprehensive launch plans including tiering, target audiences, key messages, acquisition channel mix (DTC and non-DTC), investment levels, and launch cadence. · Own integrated marketing execution as part of GTM, ensuring operational excellence and clear launch choreography. · Partner closely with Product Strategy to ensure marketing execution aligns to broader GTM objectives. · Develop and compile full integrated marketing plans in partnership with commercial teams - including channels, investment, campaign frameworks, calendar, and required assets. Integrated Campaign Planning & Execution · Establishes business goals and objectives of each GTM and ensures plans are built to achieve goals. · Drive and execute cross-functional, integrated campaigns across paid, owned, earned, lifecycle, partner, and regional channels – focusing on the entire end to end customer journey. · Develop foundational launch materials ensuring accurate and compelling representation of product capabilities. Analytics-Driven Planning & Optimization · Partner with Analytics to size opportunities, forecast impact, and define launch KPIs. · Connect launch performance back to the original plan and business objectives. · Monitor in-market results post-launch and coordinate cross-channel learnings. · Continuously optimize messaging, materials, and activation strategies based on performance insights. jobgether-jobgether:lever:1b7e330f-9814-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Azure Data Engineer based in United Arab Emirates. This role offers the opportunity to strengthen cybersecurity operations by engineering reliable, scalable security data pipelines across cloud and on-premises environments. You will work with high volumes of security telemetry and help ensure critical data is available for threat detection, incident response, compliance, and cyber risk visibility. The position combines hands-on data engineering with cybersecurity, cloud technologies, automation, and data quality management. You’ll collaborate with application, infrastructure, security, governance, and vendor teams to onboard and optimize diverse data sources. The role is well suited to an engineer who enjoys troubleshooting complex ingestion challenges and improving system reliability and efficiency. You’ll operate in a highly regulated financial services environment where data integrity, security, and operational excellence are essential. This is an opportunity to make a direct impact on the organization’s ability to detect, investigate, and respond to cyber threats. Design, build, and maintain scalable security data ingestion pipelines for SIEM and cloud data platforms, including Azure Data Explorer and Log Analytics. Parse, normalize, transform, enrich, and validate structured and unstructured security telemetry using regex, JSON parsing, schema mapping, and other data-processing techniques. Partner with application owners, infrastructure and cloud teams, vendors, security stakeholders, and other internal groups to onboard new log sources and validate end-to-end data flows. Ensure the integrity, completeness, timeliness, and quality of security telemetry used for monitoring, detection, incident response, reporting, and risk management. Align security data with established schemas, naming conventions, governance standards, and organizational requirements to support downstream analytics and automation. Troubleshoot ingestion, parsing, transformation, schema, and data-quality issues across diverse platforms and environments. Maintain clear documentation covering log onboarding procedures, source requirements, data mappings, pipeline configurations, and operational support processes. Collaborate with detection engineering and security operations teams to ensure telemetry supports investigation, threat detection, response, and cyber risk use cases. Conduct telemetry gap analyses, identify missing or incomplete data sources, and recommend priorities for improving security coverage. Support logging practices that meet regulatory, audit, compliance, retention, and data-integrity requirements. Improve ingestion frameworks, automation, and onboarding processes to increase scalability, repeatability, reliability, and cost efficiency. Support infrastructure-as-code, scripting, and automation initiatives that streamline deployment and ongoing pipeline maintenance. Monitor pipeline performance and work with stakeholders to optimize ingestion reliability, throughput, and operational costs. Stay current with emerging cybersecurity telemetry formats, logging standards, data engineering practices, and cloud security data-platform capabilities. Requirements: 3+ years of relevant experience in cybersecurity, data engineering, log management, security operations, or a related technology discipline. Hands-on experience onboarding, managing, and validating log sources within SIEM, cloud data platforms, or security analytics environments. Strong understanding of data parsing, normalization, transformation, and validation, including experience with regex, JSON, XML, CSV, and both structured and unstructured data. Familiarity with security telemetry from network, endpoint, identity, application, cloud, and infrastructure environments. jobgether-jobgether:lever:6e5ebadf-00ea-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Organizational Change Management (OCM) Lead based in Brazil. This role will lead the people side of complex, technology-enabled business transformations, with a strong focus on SAP and large-scale ERP implementations. You will shape change strategies that help organizations transition effectively to new processes, systems, and ways of working. The position combines stakeholder engagement, communications, organizational readiness, training, and adoption measurement. You will work across leadership teams, business stakeholders, project teams, and consulting partners to build alignment and momentum. A key focus will be helping manufacturing organizations navigate transformation while minimizing disruption and maximizing adoption. You will have significant ownership over OCM planning, execution, governance, and continuous monitoring throughout major initiatives. Design and execute communication strategies, including executive toolkits, targeted messaging, leadership communications, and employee engagement materials. Facilitate leadership alignment sessions, stakeholder workshops, and engagement activities across different organizational levels. Create or contribute to comprehensive training strategies that prepare employees for new systems, processes, and operating models. Manage key change deliverables, including readiness assessments, management toolkits, communication materials, training plans, and adoption metrics. Monitor change-related risks, issues, dependencies, and mitigation plans throughout implementation. Track adoption and organizational readiness metrics, using insights to adjust change strategies and improve transformation outcomes. Strong knowledge of SAP platforms, with SAP S/4HANA experience strongly preferred, and an understanding of the related business processes and transformation impacts. Demonstrated experience developing change communication strategies, stakeholder engagement plans, readiness assessments, and adoption measurement frameworks. Excellent facilitation, presentation, communication, and collaboration skills across executive, management, and operational levels. Ability to build effective working relationships across client organizations, consulting teams, technology teams, and external partners. Strong ability to manage multiple change workstreams, deliverables, risks, and stakeholders within complex transformation environments.
